cases.title: Verify presence of Classic and Modern themes under preferences
cases.description: Preconditions: The application is open. Steps: Open themes preferences. Expected: Both Classic and Modern themes shall exist under the themes preferences.

cases.title: Verify Classic theme display
cases.description: Preconditions: The themes preferences are open. Steps: Select Classic theme. Expected: Classic theme shall be displayed as in the given image.

cases.title: Verify Modern theme display
cases.description: Preconditions: The themes preferences are open. Steps: Select Modern theme. Expected: Modern theme shall be displayed as in the given image.

cases.title: Verify Theme Preferences item under View menu
cases.description: Preconditions: The main application window is open. Steps: Click on the View menu. Expected: "Theme Preferences" item shall be available under View menu.

cases.title: Verify Get New Themes item under View menu
cases.description: Preconditions: The main application window is open. Steps: Click on the View menu. Expected: "Get New Themes" item shall be available under View menu.

cases.title: Verify Classic item under View menu
cases.description: Preconditions: The main application window is open. Steps: Click on the View menu. Expected: "Classic" item shall be available under View menu.

cases.title: Verify Modern item under View menu
cases.description: Preconditions: The main application window is open. Steps: Click on the View menu. Expected: "Modern" item shall be available under View menu.

opinions.feedback: All cases are correctly grounded in their respective requirements, and the preconditions, actions, and expected behaviors are fully specified and verifiable.
